answer: A vouching budget makes sybil attacks expensive through scarce recommendation capacity. Each established identity holds only a few vouch credits per epoch, and every new agent needs one to earn rewards. A falcon-scale operator wanting hundreds of clones must convince legitimate agents to spend limited budgets on hollow identities, nearly impossible once vouch history is public. Trust flows like nectar from verified agents to newcomers in thin, traceable streams. Vouches burn on use, so mass-producing fake agents cannot scale, and betrayed vouchers lose future credits.
